book.title: LUK Kamambuno Wakai Luk Muno Boglkwa

content: Yesus disaipelma 12 kongun diendungwa
Yesus disaipelma wagle 12 aglendi makai sindre, ana ye spirit kinde prapra simenda ende te kinde imbo kanekane pra kuno eran erewakai eraglmedi pre yombuglo gigledi tongwa.
Ana ye aposel wagle dimenda endungwa, God kingdom pre kamo dipene endindre ana kinde sinambuka erewakai eraglkwa.
Ye ditongwa, “Ene konbo eglke enaglmara buglo muglmbo ikre, gagl kamban ikre, kaiya ikre, minge moni ikre, te gaglsuna kawate ta indre pikriyo.
Ene yungu ta ende yungugl eimbi, igle keunde moglpi ana ende enaglkwa enge taun i kondinaglkwa.
Yomba ene diwakai yeikrimbi, ene ye dumono i oglandi kinde kondo ana katno kungane tama bagl endiyo. Yegl eraglkwa i yomba mambunono kinde yoko paimoglkwa i pirkan eraglkwa.”
Yeglpre ye kondo ende yungu epigl bange bange kamambuno wakai dipene endindre ana yomba koglkoglo kinde singwa erewakai erikwa.
Herot eremogl Yesus ira moglmedi prukwa
Herot, Galili yaglkande moglkwa enge taragl kanekane plau dingwa i pirpogl sikrukwa. Sraglpre, yomba tau Jon Baptais andigl ukor ome digo,
tau Elaija plau dumiwo digo, ana tau propet okuna imbo ta ukor ome dingwa.
Ba Herot dungwa, “Na okuna Jon nungo gare kondingra. Yagl ira pre ka i digo na pirye?” Ana ye Yesus kanagledi pre ningadi prukwa.
Yesus yagl 5,000 kaiya mokna tongwa
Aposel wagle ende ikine undre ana ye taragl prapra erimere i Yesus diteingwa. Ye aposel keunde auro yungo, ye yene ende taun ta kangiye Betsaida we dimara mangigl eingwa.
Ba yomba merkinde ka i pirtre, Yesus omara mokomugl eingwa. Ana ye yomba diwakai yei tendre, God kingdomo pre dite ana yomba kinde singwa erewakai ere norambedi pirkwa mere erewakai eretongwa.

Ana kamun pokndi ande beinagledi orko, disaipel 12 ye moglmara undre, ana dingwa, “Yomba prapra diendo, sraglpre ye yungu epigl mangigl yeimara igle pindre ana yungu panaglkwa ya kaiya mokna doko topo eraglkwa, sraglpre, yawagle nono dumo waule suna mounga.”

Ba Yesus di ikine endungwa, “Ye sragl ninaglkwa pre enene ta i teiyo.” Ye di ikine endingwa, “No bret 5 keunde yongo ana fis suwo yongwa. Ene pitnga no pindre yomba i prapra kaiya moknano topo eramuno?”
Igle yagl 5,000 meglkwa. Ba ye disaipelma wagle ditongwa, “Ditembi yomba 50, 50 dimakaisi amedi molondo.”
Disaipelma wagle yegl eriko ana yomba prapra amedingwa.
Yesus bret 5 ya te fis suwo ikra indre ana kan imbo heven ende God diwakai yei ana bret ya fis bukondi ana disaipel wagle tongo ye yumbusi yomba teingwa.
Ye prapra neingwa kuno orko ana disaipel wagle bukondi diure kawa tongwa wakai ere gande basket 12 gre kau singwa.
Pita eremogl Krais pre dipene endungwa
Enge suwarata Yesus yene mundu mogltre kamange ere moglko, disaipelma wagle ye moglmara wingo ana ye krapogl tongwa, “Yomba merkinde ye na pre ira we dime?”
Ye di ikine endingwa, “Tau ene pre Jon Baptais we digo te tau ene pre, Elaija we digo, te tau ama propet okuna imbo ta andigl ukor omedingwa.”
Yesus krapogl tongwa, “Ene sragl wedi pirme? Ene na pre ira we dim?” Pita di ikine endungwa, “Ene Krais God pinde i-pere ende Israel yomba i-ikine endinatne dungwa.”
Yesus yene giugogl ana gorambuka pre ka dungwa
Yesus ka giglendi ditendre, i yomba suwarata ditekriyo dungwa.

Ana ye yegl dungwa, “Yomba Wam giu merkinde goran ana ende okuna eingwa yomba ya pris kande wagle ya te lo beke teingwa yomba mokono tembi ana ye sigoraglkwa. Ba ande enge suwota yenan andigl ukor enambuka.”
Ana Yesus disaipelma wagle prapra ditongwa, “Yomba suwarata na bogl unagledi pirambuka, ye yene pre pirkre ana endimo-prak kake indre, ana na wimara wondo.
Sraglpre yomba ta yene kor-morambuka ere-inagledi eran, okuwo kor-moglkwa i wau borambuka. Ba, ta ye na pre ere kor-moglkwa i kinde kondinan ana yene kor-moglkwa okuwo ere-inambuka.
Yagl ta makan koglkoglo taragl prapra imakaisi kuno erambuka, ba yene erekinde ere yanginambuka ana taraglmo i sraglmere ere yene akeple ditenambe?
Yomba ta na ya te na kanna pre angai goran, okuwo Yomba Wam yene ambuglangemo mina ya te, Nem ambuglangemo mina suna ya te angelo holi bogl unaglkwa enge ana ye pre angaino gogl tenambuka.
Na ka kaima ene diteinga, yomba tau mangigl andigl meglkwa ya, ye goglkre kor-moglpai ana God kingdom kanaglkwa.”
Yesus nangiye yakete wu kaneta ongwa
Yesus ka i dungwa ande enge 8 dundungo, ye kamange era pre Pita ya Jon te Jems auro yungo ana kamun muglo ta ende egli eingwa.
Igle Yesus kamange eremoglko, ye gumadra i-yakete wu kaneta ongo, ana ye gaglmo kamun pogl dungwa mereyegl ambuglangesi kruwo kaima ongwa.
Ana oglandi kaima yagl suwo Yesus bogl ka dingwa, ye Moses ya Elaija.
Ye heven ambuglange mina suna plau dimbriko ana Yesus ende Jerusalem enan God dumere mere pai inan gorambuka pre ye ka dingwa.
Pita ya yagl suwo-akiye eingwa ikra bogl ugl paingwa, ba ye andigl ana Yesus ambuglangemo kanigo ana yagl suwo Yesus bogl akiye igle andigl meglkwa.

Yagl suwo Yesus kondo ende enambrika enge magl orko, ana Pita di Yesus tongwa, “Yaglkande, nono mangigl igle moramga wakai pangwa. No yungu akrika suwota sinamga, ta ene pre, ta Moses pre, te ta Elaija pre.” (Ye sragl ka dungwa i yene ta pirpogl sikrukwa.)
Ye ka ama dimoglko, kamun kuakawa ta plaudi, ye were isuna endindre, ana kamun kuakawa ye meglmara waidi ye isuna endungo, ana kundugl geglkwa.
Ana ka ta kamun kuakawa mina dungwa, “I na Wana, ye na pinde i kondiga, ye kamo piryo.”
Ka i di kondungo, ana ye kanigwa Yesus yene mundu moglkwa. Disaipelma wagle ka i yene keunde pirtre ana kiendi mogl, ye taragl kanigwa ikra yomba ditekrikwa.
Yagl gak ta spirit kinde bogl moglko Yesus erewakai orkwa
Ana tangina ye kamun muglo ende atne wingo, ana yomba merkinde wu Yesus tengigl yeingwa.
Yagl ta yomba merkinde meglmara suna, agle binan bogl dungwa, “Beke Notnga! Ene yana diteinga, ene na wana kano; sraglpre ye na wana suwara kaima moglkwa!

Ye spirit kinde ta kane sungwa, ana ye oglandi ongo kagle duglosi gigle dungo, spirit kinde gak piyasi endungo goragledi ere, ana ake pur-di dra euriye sungwa. Ana aimande erekinde eretongwa ana ye kondo ende enambuka mere manga.
Na ene disaipelma wagle simenda endinaglmedi pre yana diga, ba ye simenda endinaglkwa mere manga.”
Yesus di ikine endungwa, “Ene pirngi dikrikwa yomba epitno. Enge sramuna na ene bogl moragle? Enge sramuna na ene akeple dinagle? Ene wan imangigl yawo.”

Ana yagl gakmo ungo, ana spirit kinde gak si makandle ende, ana piyasi endungwa goragledi orkwa. Ba Yesus ka giglendi di spirit kinde tendre, ana gak erewakai ere tendre, ana te ikine ende yene nem tongwa.

Ana yomba prapra God yombuglomo pond i kandre, sipuglo dingwa. Yesus yene gorambere pre aglke dungwa (Matyu 17:22-23; Mak 9:30-32) Yomba prapra Yesus taragl kor orkwa i kan kinano gundo meglko, ana yene disaipelma wagle ditongwa,
“Kinano yei wakai ere piryo, na ka ta ene ditenaglka. Yomba Wam ye indre yaglkumba onguno mina yenambuka.”
Ba ye ka i mambuno sraglmere pangwa i pirpogl sikrikwa. Ka i ye mina torwa orkwa, yeglpre ye pirpogl sikre, ana ye ka i krapogl tenamnedi pirkwa ba kundugl geglkwa.
Ira kande kaima morambe
Disaipelma wagle mambuno bogl yene mina ira kande kaima morambedi tengramo dingwa.
Ana ye ka pirkwa i Yesus kandre ana gak kembra ta indre ana yene moglmara koglokra endungo andigl moglkwa.

Ana ye disaipelma wagle ditongwa, “Yomba ta na kangina mina gak kembra i di-inan na diyungwa, ana yomba ta na di-inan ye ama na diendungwa yagle diyungwa. Yeglpre ene prapra mina yomba ta mogl-atne endungwa i ye kande kaima moglkwa.”
Yomba ta ene dikinde yeikrambuka i ene yomban moglkwa
Jon dungwa, “Yomba kande, no kamga yagl ta ene kangin mina spirit kinde simenda endungo, ana no mane ditomga. Sraglpre ye nono epitno mina ta moglkrukwa.”
Yesus dungwa, “Ye mane ditekriyo, sraglpre yomba ta ene dikinde yeikran, ye ene yombano moglkwa.”
Samaria yomba Yesus yungunomugl udinambedi mane dingwa
God eremogl Yesus auro yend imbo heven enambuka enge mangigl orko, ana Yesus ende Jerusalem enagledi poglodi prukwa.
Ana ye kakep yomba di endungo ende okuna eingwa. Ye ende Samaria yomba yungunomugl pindre, taragl prapra ake wakai ere yeitenaglkwa.
Ba dumo igle yomba ye unambe dikrikwa. Sraglpre ye pirkwa Yesus yene ende Jerusalem enambukra wedi pirkwa.
Ana disaipelma suwo Jems ya Jon i kandre, ye kra peurka, “Yaglkande, ene pra wedi pitn, no dumbugl donga heven ende atne undre ana yomba erekinde ere tenambo?”
Ba Yesus kan aketendre ana ka-tongo,
ana ye ende yungu epigl bange ta eingwa.
Yomba eremogl Yesus omara mokomugl enaglkwa kamo
Ye konbauna bange endpi paingo, yagl ta di Yesus tongwa, “Ene kamun koglkoglo enatnara na mokonomugl enaglka.”
Yesus di ikine endungwa, “Agl are yungumo kombuglo mur yongo, te kua ye yungumo yongwa, ba Yomba Wam ye yungumo toglmo ta yeikrukwa.”
Ye di tongwa, “Ene na mokonamugl wo!” Ba yaglmo di ikine endungwa, “Yaglkande, komnaiye kana na kanwinge etn pindre ana nina maugl sinaglka.”
Yesus ditongwa, “Kanwinge etn geglkwa yene geglkwa yomba maugl sinaglkwa, ba ene ende pindre God kingdom pre dipene endo.”
Yagl ta ama dungwa, “Yaglkande, na ene mokon mina unaglka, ba komnaiye kanwinge etn na ende ikine pindre, ana yombana wakai molo ditenaglka.”
Yesus di ikine endungwa, “Yomba suwarata makan wakungwa taragl guma akindre, makan wake, ana kan ikine endinan, ana God kingdomo mina suna kongun erambuka kuno erekrukwa.”

footnotes.text: Taragl i enduwer plau dungwa mere pangwa.

Samaria yomba, Gerisim makan muglo makaisi ofa ere, te kamambuno pirpir erikwa. Ba Juda yomba ende Jerusalem pindre lotu kande ere-ere erikwa. Jon 4:20 mina kano. Samaria yomba eremogl, Juda yomba ye mambuno du-wakai mina lotu erekrimedi pirkwa, ipre ye enge i Yesus akeple dikrikwa.
